segments.name: Pest control
segments.description: Provides pest, termite and wildlife control services to residential and commercial customers worldwide through company-owned and franchised locations.
segments.evidence: We operate under one reportable segment which contains our three service offerings:

revenueModel.text: Residential and commercial customers pay under contracts specifying pricing for recurring pest prevention treatments, plus ancillary and one-time services; franchisees pay initial fees and royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: Our pest and termite control services are performed pursuant to terms of contracts that specify the pricing arrangement with the customer.
